notes.title: Demo release NOW
notes.notes: [p]Thank you to the organizers of debut festival for letting me end the festival on a bang: The Hand of Hexes demo is out now! Featuring a reduced set of characters, maps, levels and acts from the final game, I hope you have a great time and let me know what you think! Updates will be rolled out in the coming days[/p]

notes.title: Demo soon and merchant update
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Development has been pretty smooth and steady. I managed to knock out some key features, such as visual indicators for tower placement, a merchant event and a lot of visual pizzaz. So things are looking pretty good for a demo release later in the month!  There are various other minor things I would like to include, like a save system besides the basic one I have for settings etc. so far. [/p][p]At the moment, there are only about 17 playable cards and towers, so I would like to also crank that number up until release. If you have any thoughts about a quantity for the demo, let me know! [/p][p]Have a nice day, [/p][p]Emmanuel[/p]
